segments: A full shot of two identical, fluffy ginger cats are sitting on a plain, light-grey background.
One ginger cat is on the left, with its paws visible.
The other ginger cat is on the right, with its mouth clearly visible.
On a plain, light-grey background,
the ginger cat on the left stretches its front paws forward.
At the same time, the ginger cat on the right opens its mouth in a wide yawn.
Three identical, classic wooden rocking chairs are positioned against a simple, off-white wall.
The first wooden rocking chair is in the foreground.
The second wooden rocking chair is to its left.
and the third wooden rocking chair is to its right.
Against a simple, off-white wall,
the first wooden rocking chair rocks back and forth steadily.
while the second wooden rocking chair gently swivels from side to side.
The third wooden rocking chair has a leg that trembles slightly.
Two identical vintage table lamps with large fabric shades stand on a neutral-colored surface.
The table lamp on the left has its light bulb clearly visible.
The table lamp on the right also has its light bulb clearly visible.
On a neutral-colored surface,
the light of the table lamp on the left flickers erratically.
Meanwhile, the light of the table lamp on the right slowly dims and then brightens.
Four identical, shiny green apples are arranged in a row on a plain white background.
The first green apple has a smooth, unblemished skin.
The second green apple has its stem and a single leaf visible.
The third green apple is perfectly round.
The fourth green apple also has a single leaf attached.
In a row on a plain white background,
the first green apple develops a small, dark bruise on its side.
the second green apple's stem wiggles back and forth.
a single water droplet rolls down the side of the third green apple.
and the leaf on the fourth green apple slowly curls inwards.
Two identical paperback books with plain blue covers are standing upright on a simple wooden shelf.
The paperback book on the left is slightly open.
The paperback book on the right is also slightly ajar.
On a simple wooden shelf,
the pages of the paperback book on the left flutter as if in a light breeze.
and the cover of the paperback book on the right gently closes shut.
Three identical, orange basketballs are on a minimalist grey floor.
One basketball is in the center.
Another basketball is to the left.
The last basketball is to the right.
On a minimalist grey floor,
the basketball in the center bounces high and slowly.
the basketball to the left bounces low and fast.
and the basketball to the right slowly rolls to a complete stop.
Two identical potted cacti, each with a single, closed flower bud, are set against a soft, neutral-toned backdrop.
The potted cactus on the left has its flower bud pointing upwards.
The potted cactus on the right has several prominent spines visible.
Against a soft, neutral-toned backdrop,
the flower on the potted cactus on the left slowly blooms open.
while one of the spines on the potted cactus on the right twitches slightly.
Four identical white candles are lit and standing in a line on a simple, dark surface.
The first candle is on the far left.
The second candle is next to it.
The third candle is to its right.
The fourth candle is on the far right.
On a simple, dark surface,
the flame of the first candle dances wildly.
the flame of the second candle burns tall and steady.
a drop of wax slowly drips down the side of the third candle.
and the fourth candle emits a small puff of smoke.
Two identical ceramic coffee mugs are placed on a plain, light-colored countertop.
The coffee mug on the left is filled with a dark liquid.
The coffee mug on the right has its handle clearly in view.
On a plain, light-colored countertop,
steam gently rises from the coffee mug on the left.
At the same time, a thin crack appears and spreads on the handle of the coffee mug on the right.
Three identical origami paper cranes are arranged on a simple, flat, white surface.
The origami crane in the middle has its wings slightly spread.
The origami crane on the left has its head and neck clearly defined.
The origami crane on the right is balanced on its point.
On a simple, flat, white surface,
the wings of the middle origami crane flap up and down gently.
the head of the origami crane on the left bows down slowly.
and the origami crane on the right spins slowly in place.
